newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks likely to hover, eyes on dlr/yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks likely to hover, eyes on dlr/yen.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to hover on Wednesday as the market watches the yen carefully for renewed signs of strength, brokers said. They said Japan's current account surplus data for April, which will be released at 8.50 a.m. (2350 GMT), was the main point of interest.
On Tuesday, the Nikkei 225 average climbed 308.73 points, or 1.53 percent, to close at 20,532.55. Its June futures ended 330 points higher at 20,600.
"As long as the yen does not surge to 110 to the dollar or beyond, selling should not be very fierce," said a broker with a second-tier brokerage.
"Investors are going to be focusing on currencies after the current account figures are released," he added.
Many market participants expect the data to show a sharp increase from a year earlier.
